#### Description
Whilelists Python Libraries:
- copulas, hmm and pomegranate (closes #2832)
- tsfresh (closes #3084)
- LightGBM (closes #3173)
- BeautifulSoup (closes #3178)
- Facebook/Prophet (closes #3199)
- fastai (closes #3233)
- Pyramid ARIMA (closes #3234)
- punkt for nltk (closes #3367)
- Stable Baselines (closes #3369)

- Updates:
  - Miniconda to 4.5.12 (Foundation and travis)
  - Python to 3.6.8
  - numpy to 1.16.1

- Use `apt-get install -y openjdk-8-jdk openjdk-8-jre` to install JRE
- Revert changes to Dockerfile

#### Related Issue
Incorporate and closes #3368 #3334

#### Motivation and Context
Fix docker foundation build and add python libraries 

#### Requires Documentation Change
No.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
- Build docker image successfully in Linux
- Unit tests were added to verify the package installation.

#### Types of changes
- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [c] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [x] Non-functional change (xml comments/documentation/etc)

#### Checklist:
- [x] My code follows the code style of this project.
- [x] I have read the **CONTRIBUTING** [document](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] I have added tests to cover my changes.
- [x] All new and existing tests passed.
- [ ] My branch follows the naming convention `bug-<issue#>-<description>` or `feature-<issue#>-<description>`

issue_context.title: Add 'copulas' library
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
The follwoing packages are whitelisted in QuantConnect:
- [copulas](https://pypi.org/project/copulas/) ([docs](https://dai-lab.github.io/Copulas/))
- [hmm](https://github.com/hmmlearn/hmmlearn)
- [pomegranate](https://pomegranate.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html)

#### Actual Behavior
Not available.

#### Potential Solution
Adds the following in [DockerfileLeanFoundation](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/DockerfileLeanFoundation#L79):
```
pip install copulas
pip install --upgrade --user hmmlearn
conda install pomegranate
```
Testing the potential solution:
- Build the docker image with the dockerfile after the changes.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)
